name: Giske
description: An insistent housekeeper whose unwanted pursuit ends with her being made to look like the Devil, after which she takes the disguise for truth and blunders through a string of robberies.
visualPrompt: A lean, long-legged Nordic farm woman with a blunt, determined expression; hair roughly shorn short; skin and clothes smeared with greasy soot so she looks eerily blackened; wearing a simple work skirt and blouse; energetic posture, unsettling yet comic presence

name: The Widower
description: Giske’s employer, driven to desperation by her pressure to marry, who engineers the disguise that sets everything in motion.
visualPrompt: A weathered middle-aged Norwegian farmer with practical, guarded eyes; plain linen shirt and wool vest; sturdy build; holding a pair of shears and looking both guilty and relieved; rustic homestead background

name: The Thieves
description: Two would-be rustlers who first flee from Giske in terror, then accept her as a guide—until her loud questions ruin every attempt.
visualPrompt: Two scruffy countryside men in worn coats and caps, moving furtively; anxious faces that shift between greed and fear; one carrying a sack; forest shadows around them

name: The Priest
description: Summoned to ‘bind the Devil,’ he rushes out unprepared and is famously left floundering in the bog when panic erupts.
visualPrompt: An older village priest in nightcap and slippers under a hastily thrown-on coat; startled, wide-eyed expression; struggling near a soft, muddy bog with reeds and mist
